segments.sn15.20:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
segments.sn15.20:2.2: Pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
segments.sn15.20:2.3: Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa vepullassa pabbatassa ‘pācīnavaṃso’ tveva samaññā udapādi.
segments.sn15.20:2.4: Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena manussānaṃ ‘tivarā’ tveva samaññā udapādi.
segments.sn15.20:2.5: Tivarānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ cattārīsa vassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
segments.sn15.20:2.6: Tivarā, bhikkhave, manussā pācīnavaṃsaṃ pabbataṃ catūhena ārohanti, catūhena orohanti.
segments.sn15.20:2.7: Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
segments.sn15.20:2.8: Kakusandhassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vidhurasañjīvaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
segments.sn15.20:2.9: Passatha, bhikkhave, sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā, te ca manussā kālaṅkatā, so ca bhagavā parinibbuto.
segments.sn15.20:2.13: Yāvañcidaṃ, bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ, alaṃ vimuccituṃ.
segments.sn15.20:3.1: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa vepullassa pabbatassa ‘vaṅkako’ tveva samaññā udapādi.
segments.sn15.20:3.2: Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena manussānaṃ ‘rohitassā’ tveva samaññā udapādi.
segments.sn15.20:3.3: Rohitassānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ tiṃsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
segments.sn15.20:3.4: Rohitassā, bhikkhave, manussā vaṅkakaṃ pabbataṃ tīhena ārohanti, tīhena orohanti.
segments.sn15.20:3.5: Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena koṇāgamano bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
segments.sn15.20:3.6: Koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bhiyyosuttaraṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
segments.sn15.20:3.7: Passatha, bhikkhave, sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā, te ca manussā kālaṅkatā, so ca bhagavā parinibbuto.
segments.sn15.20:4.1: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa vepullassa pabbatassa ‘supasso’ tveva [suphassotveva (sī.)] samaññā udapādi.
segments.sn15.20:4.2: Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena manussānaṃ ‘suppiyā’ tveva [appiyātveva (sī.)] samaññā udapādi.
segments.sn15.20:4.3: Suppiyānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
segments.sn15.20:4.4: Suppiyā, bhikkhave, manussā supassaṃ pabbataṃ dvīhena ārohanti, dvīhena orohanti.
segments.sn15.20:4.5: Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
segments.sn15.20:4.6: Kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tissabhāradvājaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
segments.sn15.20:4.7: Passatha, bhikkhave, sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā, te ca manussā kālaṅkatā, so ca bhagavā parinibbuto.
segments.sn15.20:5.1: “Etarahi kho pana, bhikkhave, imassa vepullassa pabbatassa ‘vepullo’ tveva samaññā udapādi.
segments.sn15.20:5.2: Etarahi kho pana, bhikkhave, imesaṃ manussānaṃ ‘māgadhakā’ tveva samaññā udapādi.
segments.sn15.20:5.3: Māgadhakānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ [lahusaṃ (sī.)];
segments.sn15.20:5.4: yo ciraṃ jīvati so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo.
segments.sn15.20:5.5: Māgadhakā, bhikkhave, manussā vepullaṃ pabbataṃ muhuttena ārohanti muhuttena orohanti.
segments.sn15.20:5.6: Etarahi kho panāhaṃ, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno.
segments.sn15.20:5.7: Mayhaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sāriputtamoggallānaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
segments.sn15.20:5.8: Bhavissati, bhikkhave, so samayo yā ayañcevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antaradhāyissati, ime ca manussā kālaṃ karissanti, ahañca parinibbāyissāmi.
segments.sn15.20:5.12: Yāvañcidaṃ, bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ, alaṃ vimuccitun”ti.
segments.sn15.20:6.2: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –

lines: Dasame bhūtapubbanti atītakāle ekaṃ apadānaṃ āharitvā dasseti.
Samaññā udapādīti paññatti ahosi.
Catūhena ārohantīti idaṃ thāmamajjhime sandhāya vuttaṃ.
Agganti uttamaṃ.
Bhaddayuganti sundarayugalaṃ.
Tīhena ārohantīti ettāvatā kira dvinnaṃ buddhānaṃ antare yojanaṃ pathavī ussannā, so pabbato tiyojanubbedho jāto.
Appaṃ vā bhiyyoti vassasatato uttariṃ appaṃ dasa vā vīsaṃ vā vassāni.
Puna vassasatameva jīvanako nāma natthi, uttamakoṭiyā pana saṭṭhi vā asīti vā vassāni jīvanti.
Vassasataṃ pana appatvā pañcavassadasavassādikāle mīyamānāva bahukā.

Ettha ca kakusandho bhagavā cattālīsavassasahassāyukakāle, koṇāgamano tiṃsavassasahassāyukakāle nibbattoti idaṃ anupubbena parihīnasadisaṃ kataṃ, na pana evaṃ parihīnaṃ, vaḍḍhitvā vaḍḍhitvā parihīnanti veditabbaṃ.
Kathaṃ?
Kakusandho tāva bhagavā imasmiṃyeva kappe cattālīsavassasahassāyukakāle nibbatto āyuppamāṇaṃ pañca koṭṭhāse katvā cattāro ṭhatvā pañcame vijjamāneyeva parinibbuto.
Taṃ āyu parihāyamānaṃ dasavassakālaṃ patvā puna vaḍḍhamānaṃ asaṅkheyyaṃ hutvā tato parihāyamānaṃ tiṃsavassasahassāyukakāle ṭhitaṃ, tadā koṇāgamano nibbatto.
Tasmimpi tatheva parinibbute taṃ āyu dasavassakālaṃ patvā puna vaḍḍhamānaṃ asaṅkheyyaṃ hutvā parihāyitvā vīsavassasahassakāle ṭhitaṃ, tadā kassapo bhagavā nibbatto.
Tasmimpi tatheva parinibbute taṃ āyu dasavassakālaṃ patvā puna vaḍḍhamānaṃ asaṅkheyyaṃ hutvā parihāyitvā vassasatakālaṃ pattaṃ, atha amhākaṃ sammāsambuddho nibbatto.
Evaṃ anupubbena parihāyitvā vaḍḍhitvā vaḍḍhitvā parihīnanti veditabbaṃ.
Tattha ca yaṃ āyuparimāṇesu mandesu buddhā nibbattanti, tesampi tadeva āyuparimāṇaṃ hotīti.
Dasamaṃ.
Ekaṃ apadānaṃ āharitvā dasseti “evaṃ saṃvegaṃ janetvā bhikkhū visesaṃ pāpessāmī”ti.
Catūhena ārohanti catuyojanubbedhattā.
Dvinnaṃ buddhānanti kakusandhassa koṇāgamanassa cāti imesaṃ dvinnaṃ buddhānaṃ.
“Tivarā rohitassā suppiyā”ti manussānaṃ tasmiṃ tasmiṃ kāle samaññā tattha desanāmavasena jātāti veditabbā, yathā etarahi māgadhāti.
